title: test: cover community speech CLI registration
author: Apollohzl
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #14474

- Adds one focused CLI regression test for community `speech` registration.
- Verifies `--modality speech` and `completionAudioPrice` reach the Account API body correctly.
- Contains no duplicate production implementation; the selected TTS implementation landed in #14387.

Runner-up bonus for the independently strong #14347 submission.

gist.headline: Speech Gets a Seat
gist.blurb: A small guard bee now watches the CLI register community speech models correctly. The wiring stays wired.
gist.summary: Added a focused regression test confirming that Polli CLI community model registration passes `--modality speech` and `completionAudioPrice` into the Account API request body.
gist.impact: Developers gain ongoing test coverage for the speech-model registration path, helping keep its modality and audio pricing fields intact.
gist.visual_concept: Polli, wearing tiny QA goggles and holding a clipboard, checks a cozy retro terminal command labeled `--modality speech`; a small code-plant grows beside an Account API envelope containing a musical note and price tag. This represents a test safeguarding the existing TTS registration wiring.
